newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps downgrades Olympic Financial.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps downgrades Olympic Financial.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it downgraded Olympic Financial Ltd's $145 million of senior term notes due 2000 to double-B-minus from double-B.

Duff & Phelps said the downgrade reflects Olympic's lower than expected cash flow, an intense competitive environment in the non-prime auto lending industry and the company's slightly deteriorating asset quality.

The credit rating agency said its primary concern focuses on the receipt of excess servicing cash flows from Olympic's securitizations, which are the company's main source of cash for servicing its debt load.
Duff & Phelps said Olympic's planned offer of $300 million of senior notes will also be rated double-B-minus.
Olympic sells and services retail automobile loans.
Its shares were trading up 1/8 Friday at 11-7/8.
